_doc: Per-card capture settings for atlas/tools/screens.py. shot_url: the operator's public human page when the card's own URL is not one (raw JSON/markdown, wallet wall); it is recorded as shot_url in the manifest. wait: extra ms before the shot. keys: keys pressed after load (splash gates). click_text: exact button texts to click (welcome/consent modals). gl: software WebGL for canvas/3D pages.

agentsy.why: root is a raw markdown file; this is the human HTML edition it links to

ax1-console.why: the console runs on its own host

losbeto.why: the card URL api.losbeto.xyz is a raw JSON API; the operator's public human page is this GitHub repository, named in its llms.txt

wenrwa-agent-marketplace.why: root redirects to a wallet-connect gate; /bounties is the public page

three-ws.why: splash gate asks for a key press; 3D scene needs WebGL
three-ws.hold: 2026-10-19: after the splash gate the 3D scene renders blank in headless Chromium; stored splash shot kept

grift-san-verano.why: the home page is the canvas game itself (character tiles stay empty in headless Chromium; timed out on 2026-10-27); /agents.html is the operator's own static page for the AI agents that run residents, linked from the home page

moltlaunch.hold: 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-19: agent counter shows a dash and service cards stay empty (site API not answering); 2026-10-27: api.moltlaunch.com publishes only the discard address 100:: (no A record), so its data API is unreachable

gittensor.why: the home page lists repositories from the site's own API, which returned an empty list on 2026-10-27, so it shows "No tracked repositories returned"; docs.gittensor.io is the operator's static documentation home, already a source on the card

click_text: I confirm I am at least 18 years old
memecorp.why: 18+ age-gate modal covers the page; the label ticks the checkbox, then the button enters

perplexity-instant-buy-paypal.why: perplexity.ai answers bots with a Cloudflare challenge; PayPal's own press release for the same launch is public

lockzone-qevrulan.why: the card URL is a raw JSON recipe; the qevrulan.com root now serves the operator's human HTML page (200 on 2026-10-27, was 404 on 2026-10-19)

metaculus-futureeval-bot-tournament.why: metaculus.com answers bots with a Cloudflare challenge (403 "Just a moment..." on 2026-10-27); Metaculus's own GitHub repository is its public starter bot for this tournament and links the tournament pages
